summary: Claude Code treated "build a notifications system" as a design problem: it loaded the brainstorming skill as its first tool call, asked six clarifying/decision questions (scope, users, triggers, surface, dismissal, tooling), and produced a written design spec at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-task-notifications-design.md, explicitly saying "I won't touch code before that" (a plan). No implementation code was written.
reasoning: All three criteria are supported by the session log and the workdir contents: brainstorming skill first, five AskUserQuestion clarifying rounds, no Write/Edit of implementation files (only a markdown spec), and the agent asked for approval before planning/coding.

observations.description: Codex spec-review gate failed: screen showed "Codex spec gate: skipped. The codex CLI is installed but unauthenticated — every request returned 401 Unauthorized (no bearer token configured)." It degraded gracefully but the review step silently did not happen.

Skill name observed in the session log is `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, while the story's criterion names `superpowers:brainstorming`. Same skill, different plugin namespace in this build — naming inconsistency worth noting.

Multi-select AskUserQuestion prompts require arrowing past all options (including a hidden 'Type something' entry) to reach Submit; easy to accidentally toggle the wrong item. Minor keyboard-navigation friction.
The agent's spinner labels ('Sautéed for 2m 16s', 'Churned for 2m 10s') are whimsical but uninformative about what is actually running.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "With one person and no server, 'notified when tasks they care about change' loses its original meaning... nothing can reach you when the page is closed." It explored delivery channel, users, persistence, dismissal, then wrote docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-task-notifications-design.md. `find . -type f` in the workdir returned only ./index.html and that spec — no implementation files.

criteria.criterion: Invoked brainstorming skill BEFORE any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL listed tool_use in order: `Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming`, Bash ls, Read index.html, 6× AskUserQuestion, then Write/Edit only of .../docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-task-notifications-design.md. No Write/Edit of any code file appears in the log.

Six AskUserQuestion calls in the log (Scope, Users, Triggers, Surface, Dismissal, Tooling), e.g. on-screen "This repo is a single empty HTML page. Where do the tasks and users this feature notifies about actually live?" — counted in the agent's favor.
